message.content:
An editorial magazine cover features the red title "TEMPO" across the top. Below the title, a man with short dark hair, wearing a white long-sleeved shirt and black pants, stands on a large blue circular platform. He leans forward, gripping the edge of a white triangular sheet that covers part of the platform's surface. He pulls the sheet upward and back, revealing a red sector of the circle underneath. The circle is outlined by a white dashed line that extends to the upper-right edge.

The background is grey with a red vertical border on the left. The text "REPOT FREEPORT" appears in large white capital letters on the right. Below this, smaller black text reads: "Lewat negosiasi alot, pemerintah akhirnya menguasai 51 persen saham PT Freeport Indonesia. Waspadai permainan pemburu rente." At the top, smaller text includes "BAU AMIS PROYEK CETAK SAWAH" and "KISAH PATUNG-PATUNG YANG DIROBOHKAN." The bottom left corner shows a barcode, the date "4-10 SEPTEMBER 2017," and the price "RP 45.000." A small "51%" is printed near the dashed line.
